description: Paid automatic before-payment gate for x402 clients. Call after receiving the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge but before creating/signing the merchant payment. Returns firewall_action ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK plus signed proof. ALLOW means the wallet/client may proceed only if its own spending authority also permits the payment. Machine price: $0.001 via x402.

category.description: Optional purchase/service category for audit context.

merchant_id.description: Optional stable merchant identifier; defaults to the resource hostname.

payment_required.description: Merchant's real x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload, decoded or encoded.

body.description: Exact request body to bind to the firewall decision.

method.description: HTTP method of the exact merchant request.

url.description: Absolute merchant resource URL that produced the x402 challenge.

name: firewall_before_payment
